messages:
Maya: Heads up — we're seeing a sudden egress burst from the embeddings read store in us-east1. 5xx rate ~12% for affected requests, customer-facing errors reported. Investigating now. https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2789054321 :warning:
Ops-Bot: Incident created: INC-2789054321. Pager sent to oncall. Runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/embeds-read-burst
Alex (oncall): Acknowledged. Reproducing with live traffic probes, collecting logs. Attaching initial query: `curl -sS -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings?region=us-east1\"`
Simon: Infra: scaling read-pool + enabling egress-costguard policy (temp) across us-east1 edge nodes. Patch rolling to 3/3 nodes now. Will monitor tail latency and 5xx.
Lia: SRE: adding a short-term KV cache bypass rule and increasing kv-connection timeouts per runbook. Also pushing a metrics alert to reduce noisy retries.
Chris (product): Notifying CS and key impacted customers with a short blurb. We should mention ETA for mitigation once Alex confirms stabilization.
Maya: Mitigation step 1: enable egress-costguard (rate-limit downstream egress per-tenant) — in flight. Step 2: autoscale read-pool + prewarm connections. Step 3: if degradation continues, fallback to smaller embedding shards.
Alex (oncall): Done: egress-costguard enabled (policy id: costguard-2026-03). Applied quick autoscale: +20% read capacity. Observed immediate drop in retries.
Simon: Metrics update: 5xx rate decreased from 12% -> 3.1% in 5m after policy. Tail latency P95 down ~180ms. Still watching KV error spikes on node 7.
Lia: Running post-mitigation health checks: `python tools/healthcheck.py --service embeds-read --region us-east1 --check-errors` — no fatal errors returned, small number of degraded connections being drained.
Maya: Customer impact: partial degradation for a subset of higher-throughput tenants in us-east1 (embed reads). Non-blocking for most low-volume users. Customer-facing status update drafted: \"We experienced elevated errors for embeddings in us-east1; mitigation in progress. Follow https://status.redwood.ai for updates.\"
Chris (product): Approved customer blurb. CS notified.
Alex (oncall): Next actions: continue monitoring for 30m, plan targeted rollback of policy if any regressions. If KV errors persist on node 7, we'll cordon and replace node.
Ops-Bot: Update INC-2789054321: mitigation applied, monitoring. Links: task-run: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/81234, logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/2789054321
Simon: Noted a correlated bump in egress-to-thirdparty region-us mirror — investigating whether a downstream partner throttled back. Adding partner support channel.
Maya: Final status (preliminary): mitigation reduced customer impact; tracking for full resolution. Will post a summary + RCA stub once we have root cause.
Chris (product): FYI execs will want a short one-liner: \"Brief embeddings read disruption in us-east1; mitigations (egress-costguard + autoscale) restored most traffic; followup RCA pending.\"
Lia: Leave a pointer for postmortem: tag logs + traces with `INC-2789054321` and collect a sample of failed request IDs for correlation.
Alex (oncall): Closing note — continuing observation. If anything spikes again, ping #incidents-escalation and I'll re-open pager. :white_check_mark:
Maya: Thanks team, posting to status page now and emailing impacted customers.
